_comment: Shared-model manifest for gen_catalog.py. Maps an app id to the SHARED model files it needs dropped into device directories at install time -- for apps whose package does NOT bundle the model (one-gen models[]+target_path parity). gen_catalog hashes the real staged bytes; nothing here is hand-written except the file list + target_path. Apps absent from this map get models: [] (their model is bundled inside the package).
_schema: Two accepted per-app forms. (a) SINGLE target (backward compatible): {"target_path": "/abs/dir", "files": ["a", "b"]} -- files staged at <models-dir>/<app_id>/<file>. (b) MULTI target: {"groups": [{"target_path": "/abs/dir", "files": [...]}, {"target_path": "/abs/dir/sub", "subdir": "sub", "files": [...]}]} -- each group has its OWN target_path so different files can land in different device subdirs. Optional per-group "subdir" is the staging path segment under <models-dir>/<app_id>/ AND the URL path segment (default "", i.e. files directly under the app stage). Filenames are always bare basenames. Each staged file becomes one catalog models[] entry {url, filename, sha256, size, target_path} -- the entry shape is identical for both forms; groups only change where the bytes come from and where they land.
